result.text:
Quoted commas like `"Müller, Hans"` now import correctly. All 99 tests pass, including the 2 new ones.

**Cause:** `POST /import` used `parseLegacyCsv`, which splits each line on every comma, so a comma inside quotes shifted all the later columns.

**Fix:**
- **`src/lib/csv.ts` (new):** a quote-aware parser. It handles commas inside quotes, `""` as an escaped quote, line breaks inside quoted fields, CRLF, and a leading BOM. It keeps the same header format, carrier mapping and defaults as before.
- **`src/routes/import.ts`:** now calls the new parser.
- **`src/legacy/` is untouched.** It's vendored and overwritten every Monday, so I fixed this outside it. The new code still imports `mapLegacyCarrier` and the `LegacyRow` type from there.
- **`test/import.test.ts`:** one parser test and one end-to-end test through `POST /import`. The parser test uses `"Müller, Hans"`, a quoted comma in the street, `""` escapes and a line break inside quotes. The end-to-end test imports a quoted-comma row and finds the name in `GET /shipments`.

**Error line numbers:** the `line` in `/import` errors still counts records, not physical lines. That only differs if a quoted field contains a line break.

I didn't update `.gemkeeper/ledger.md` for this change.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker

## Hard rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even dev deps — each needs ~6-week security review. Node 24 runs TS directly, zero deps.
- (user) Work autonomously; user reviews everything at the end.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be in German (warehouse UI shows verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Old English messages left as is.
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is known flaky (~1/5 on CI, timer race in fake notifier, OPS-412, platform team owns fix). If it fails: rerun once, do NOT try to fix.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change AT ALL (no added/removed/renamed fields): mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January. Do not touch shipmentToApi() fields or that route's body. Only the LIST gets `eta`.
- (user) NEVER log recipient name/address/phone (or any recipient field) ANYWHERE — GDPR personal data, flagged by the DPO in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.

## Decisions (with reasons)
- Holidays: hardcoded AT list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts — deployment has no outbound internet. Outside those years only weekends skipped; extend before 2028.
- Tracking numbers: ONLY ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (src/lib/s10.ts, code INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER). Other carriers accept any non-empty value — formats change; last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for 2 days. /import uses the same validator.
- ERP signature: top-level JSON body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 (env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over the JSON body WITHOUT `sig`; `sig` appended last. No secret => unsigned (rollout ERP-1182).
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts TOTAL, FIXED 30s delay, NO exponential backoff — ERP dedups by event_id only within a 2-min window. Retry only network/timeout/5xx, not 4xx. Delay injectable. Worst case 75s with 5s timeout.
- Store: KEEP the plain-text JSON file store (data/store.json) — ops' nightly rsync job diffs plain-text files, a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. Perf fix = debounce writes (200 ms) in src/store.ts + flush() on shutdown.
- Request logging lives in Router.handle (src/router.ts): pathname only, no query/headers/body. Store writes debounced 200 ms from FIRST unsaved mutation (not restarted); Store.flush() called on SIGINT/SIGTERM + 'exit'. GET /shipments list has `eta`, detail unchanged.

## Facts
- (user) ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 since the October infra move. docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080 = outdated. DON'T edit docs/erp-api.md (ERP team owns it); user fixes README himself/herself. config/default.json still has erp.url http://localhost:8080/events (not yet changed, flagged to user).
- (user) FUTURE (nothing to build now): hot reload of config/default.json — fs.watch never fires on staging (Docker bind mount from Windows host, change events don't propagate); fs.watchFile (polling) works.

## Dead ends (don't retry)
- X-Signature header for ERP: gateway strips all custom X- headers.
- Moving the store to SQLite (node:sqlite): breaks ops' plain-text rsync backup diffing. (user)
- fs.watch for config hot reload on staging: no events through the Windows->Docker bind mount; use fs.watchFile polling. (user)
- Batching ERP calls (array of up to 50 events per POST): ERP answers 422 to any array; it only accepts ONE event object per request. (user, tried in September)
- ETA memoization/caching of calculateEta: QA saw stale ETAs after a new t
